title: Gap-Six Reconstruction, Complex Harmonic Determinants, and Stieltjes Boundary Collisions
novelty_scope: New contributions relative to inspected repository frontier; established transformations and Euler values are credited. No exhaustive historical-priority claim.
proof_audit: Independent internal audit; not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization.

claims.label: gs:main
claims.statement: For p=2b-6, q=2b, b>=4, the first q moments have formal rank q and reconstruct all later moments.

claims.label: gs:ordinary
claims.statement: For every gap-six pair the explicitly defined even polynomial and sextic subtraction give an ordinary absolutely convergent rational polygamma-tail sum equal to -1/2.

claims.label: cr:primitive
claims.statement: A symmetric rational matrix primitive of w p p^T is generically nonsingular for nonzero rational w and constant-linearly independent rational components of p, over any characteristic-zero field.

claims.label: cr:degree
claims.statement: Generic formal harmonic degree equals generic pencil rank for every nonzero complex rational weight, with finitely many admissible cutoff exceptions.

claims.label: hp:hahn-top
claims.statement: The adjacent-pole highest harmonic coefficient is a fixed three-by-three Hahn determinant for arbitrary particle count.

claims.label: hp:roots
claims.statement: At positive real shift and the stated cutoffs, all nonzero residue exceptions are simple real parameters -1-1/(a+xi_j), with xi_j orthogonal polynomial zeros.

claims.label: hp:all-r-generator
claims.statement: For R(n)=1/(n+1)+eta/(n+2), every cutoff generator lies in the rational function span of 1, L, L^2, Li_2(x).

claims.label: hp:triple
claims.statement: Explicit three-particle Vandermonde-square ensemble equals the displayed quadratic harmonic expression.

claims.label: hp:endpoint
claims.statement: The sixth Euler primitive of the positive ensemble has the stated ordinary-zeta endpoint.
claims.classical_inputs: Height-one Gamma quotient, convergent shuffle/stuffle laws, elementary even-zeta values.

claims.label: urc:constant-theorem
claims.statement: All Stieltjes indices and argument-derivative orders have the exact displayed constant correction at fixed positive rates.

claims.label: urc:full-theorem
claims.statement: Complete singular power-log expansion and constant, locally uniformly in both spectral parameters.
The unrestricted unequal-even-order optimal-prefix conjecture is not resolved.
The full gap-eight family is not resolved here.
The stronger sign f_b>0 for every b>=7 is not proved by the modular residues; positivity is established only for b>=2048.
The manuscript short Gaussian S6 and revised S8 identities remain conjectural; the old rejected S8 candidate is not revived.
